question: How can the receptive subject be conceived as separate while its essence is non-different from you?
premises: It is likened to a tree seed.
Its essence is non-difference from you.
inference: Even when conceived as a receptive seed-like subject, its true essence remains non-different from you.
plain_english: This receptive one, like a tree seed, is also conceived, yet its essence is non-difference from you.
